title: npm user config with registry tokens
whyItMatters: The user npmrc can hold auth tokens for package registries, which allow publishing or private downloads as this user.
notes: Project-level .npmrc files inside repositories are out of scope for this home-folder rule.

cleanup.signOut: Sign out of the registry with npm's sign-out option, or revoke the token on the registry website, so the saved token stops working.
steps: Sign out of or revoke the registry token.
Delete the file named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes the npm registry tokens from this PC. Tokens that are not revoked keep allowing publishes and private downloads.
